title: Clifford spectrum of three 2 by 2 matrices
summary: We prove that the Clifford spectrum associated to three 2 by 2 matrices is nonempty. The structure of Clifford is described in terms "moving" level curves. We discuss some implication of a conjecture formulated for arbitrary size n by n of three matrices and give an example in the case of three self-adjoint operators in the infinite dimensional Hilbert space.
